'''Notru'denn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Notru'denn worked as the personal assistant of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noblewoman [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]]. He attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'' and during it, Aldrete sent him to speak to a group of the guests, who had attracted her attention. He invited them into his office and they revealed to him that they were agents of the [[Alderaanian Resistance]] and that they wanted Aldrete's help to gain clearance codes to travel to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. He agreed to help and told Aldrete about them. However, moments later, the ''Gem'' was [[Battle of the Gem of Alderaan|attacked]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and they cut its communications. Notru'denn gave the resistance agents two sporting [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] that he had hidden beneath his desk and told them to go and stop them. He remained behind and tried to restore the communications systems so that he could send out a distress call.
